 Banks Closed For Three Days? Check State-Wise Holiday Details For November 14 to 16
 Bank branches will remain closed for three days in select cities, while digital banking and online fund transfers will continue during holidays
 O Outlook Money Updated on: 14 November 2026 12:48 pm Updated on: 14 November 2026 12:48 pm SUBSCRIBE 
 Photo: AI generated Photo: AI generated Summary of this article
 Banks close nationwide November 14–15, extending to November 16 in Patna, Ranchi.
 Regional bank holidays continue across select cities on November 20, 23, 24, 27.
 Branch services pause during closures, while ATMs, UPI, digital banking operate normally.
 Bank branches follow a calendar of weekly closures and holidays linked to festivals and regional occasions. While some holidays apply across the country, others are restricted to particular cities or states. Customers planning branch visits over the weekend and the start of next week should check which closures apply in their area.

 BY Priyanka Debnath 
 Continue Reading Are Banks Closed Across India For Three Consecutive Days?
 Bank branches across India will remain closed on November 14 and 15, but the three-day closure will not apply nationwide. November 14 is the second Saturday of the month, followed by the regular Sunday holiday on November 15. On November 16, banks in Patna, Bihar, and Ranchi, Jharkhand, will remain closed for Chhath Puja . Branches in other cities will follow their respective local holiday schedules.
 Other Bank Holidays In November 2026
 Apart from these closures, the Reserve Bank of India’s holiday calendar lists several regional bank holidays during the remaining part of November.
 On November 20, banks in Dehradun will remain closed for Igas-Bagwal. On November 23, branches in Shillong will observe a holiday for Seng Kut Snem.
 November 24 will be a bank holiday in Aizawl, Belapur, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Chandigarh, Dehradun, Hyderabad, Itanagar, Jaipur, Jammu, Kanpur, Kohima, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, New Delhi, Raipur, Ranchi, Shimla and Srinagar. The occasions listed for this date include Guru Nanak Jayanti, Karthika Purnima and Rahas Purnima.
 Follow our WhatsApp channel Banks in Bengaluru will remain closed on November 27 for Kanakadasa Jayanti. Apart from these regional holidays, bank branches across India will also remain closed on November 22 and November 29, both Sundays. November 28 will be a nationwide closure as it is the fourth Saturday of the month.
 Which Banking Services Remain Unavailable During Holidays?
 Bank holidays affect services that require customers to visit a branch. These include over-the-counter cash deposits and withdrawals, demand draft requests, cheque-related assistance and access to bank lockers. Customers requiring these services may have to wait until branches reopen on the next working day.
 While internet banking, mobile banking, UPI , ATMs and online bill payment facilities remain available during branch closures, customers can also transfer money through NEFT and RTGS at any time, as these services are available 24 hours a day, including on Sundays and bank holidays.
